page_title: Lyrimuse: desktop lyrics for Apple Music and Spotify on Mac

summary.name: Lyrimuse
summary.one_liner: Lyrimuse is an open-source macOS app that shows word-synced lyrics on the desktop, under the notch, and in the menu bar for Apple Music, Spotify and several other players.
use_cases: sing along to lyrics while playing music on a Mac
see translations or readings of foreign-language lyrics
show lyrics on a second screen or in OBS
share currently playing song on Discord
summary.what_it_does: Lyrimuse displays word-synced lyrics in several places: a full lyrics window, a capsule under the notch, the menu bar, the Touch Bar, and an overlay above other windows. It works with Apple Music, Spotify and about nine other players, including QQ Music, NetEase Cloud Music, KKBOX and Amazon Music. Lyrics are matched from fourteen sources, with each result scored and the best one chosen; users can search for or edit a different version. It can show translations under lines and readings under words, and it can scrobble plays to Last.fm and update Discord status. Lyrics found once are cached locally so they show offline.
notable: Word-synced lyrics with translations and readings (romaji, Jyutping) under the exact words
Notch capsule and menu bar display, with a Dynamic Island-style capsule that also works on Macs without a notch
No account, telemetry or analytics; translation runs on the Mac by default
Positioned as a successor to LyricsX, whose last release was v1.6.3 from April 2022
caveats: Requires macOS 14 or later; translating lyrics on the Mac needs macOS 15 or later
Not notarized by Apple, so the first launch needs approval in System Settings → Privacy & Security
First lyric lookup for a song and online translation need an internet connection
